newsitem.title: USA: INCSTAR sets meeting for American merger.
newsitem.headline: INCSTAR sets meeting for American merger.

text.p: INCSTAR Corp said Monday it will hold a special shareholders meeting on June 26 to vote on a proposed merger with American Standard Companies Inc.
INCSTAR reached a definitive agreement in March to be acquired by American Standard in a transaction providing $6.32 in cash for each of its shares.
Under the merger proposal, INCSTAR would become part of a newly formed medical systems group within American Standard.
The merger has been approved by a special committee of independent directors and the board of directors of INCSTAR.
The transaction requires approval by a majority of shareholders.

The merger requires completion by American Standard of a previously announced agreement to acquire the European medical diagnostic business of Sorin Biomedica S.p.A., which owns 52 percent of INCSTAR.

INCSTAR develops and produces diagnostic tests and had 1996 sales of $46 million. It markets its products in North America through a direct sales force and internationally, through independent distributors and Sorin Biomedica.
If approved by INCSTAR's shareholders, the merger is expected to close on June 30, 1997.
Shareholders of record as of May 9, 1997 are entitled to vote at the special meeting.
